per_question.answer: To avoid academic warning, an undergraduate needs to maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.00 [grading-page.html / Warning/Probation].
If a student's CGPA stays below 2.00 for three consecutive semesters, their admission will be closed.

If a teacher refers a cheating case to the Department Disciplinary Committee, the maximum punishment of 'F' grade can be awarded in that course.

A student is not allowed to submit an assignment written by a generative AI tool as their own work. According to the evidence, students using the technology to simply circumvent the requirements of an assessment or using it to create entire assessments that they then disguise as their own original work is not acceptable. This includes submitting content generated by Generative AI tools without app

The percentage of tuition fee refunded if a student leaves within the first 15 days of classes is 80% of the tuition fee per credit hour. The tuition fee per credit hour is Rs. 12,000. [fee-structure-page.html / Tuition Fee (w.e.f. Fall 2026 semester)]
